role: prospective supplemental exact null calculation, added after the main sparse-CLR run showed zero transformed ties; original protocol unchanged
population: Each independent sample has f0=0.1 or 0.9 with common Bernoulli probability p, f1=1-f0; both CLR distribution nulls hold.
calculation: Enumerate counts of high-state samples in each group, weight rejection by independent binomial probabilities; this is an exact population calculation, not Monte Carlo.
screen: Flag any exact global-null FDR exceeding 0.05+1e-12; retain all failures without selecting a favorable probability or sample-size configuration.
resources: 474 count-pair states, two correction methods, two features; target under one minute and under 1 GB; no databases.
